scheme_name: Providing Mini Tractor and its Sub Parts to the Self Help Group of Scheduled Castes
other_conditions: Self Help Group must have at least 80% members from Scheduled Castes or Nav‑Buddhist.
The group must contribute 10% of the total equipment cost (₹35,000).
benefits_summary: Provides a mini tractor and essential sub‑parts valued at ₹3.5 lakh, with the government subsidizing 90% (₹3.15 lakh) and the group contributing 10% (₹35,000).
